verdict.rationale: Plausible documents funnel analysis with drop-off measurement, but nothing in the evidence shows session replay or any way to jump from a funnel step or error event to recordings of affected users. Its stated design of collecting no personal data and not building user profiles is consistent with that absence. Session replay is a fair axis for a web analytics product, so this is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can jump from a funnel drop-off or an error event straight to session replays of the affected users
